g.text: Business requirements cascade linearly to engineering with zero iterative feedback.
Delivery ends when the dashboard goes live, ignoring whether anyone actually uses it.
Reports proliferate unchecked; 80% become unmaintained 'ghost' assets within 6 months.
High technical completion, near-zero institutional adoption.

g.text: Post-occupancy evaluation: adoption telemetry, query speed, and metric trust loop back.
Equipping internal teams as flight operators with runbooks and regression tests.
Decoupled semantic foundations survive front-end BI tool and agent churn.
Self-sustaining, governed digital infrastructure built to last.
